content: HITL theatre: humans nominally in loop but involvement cosmetic (present for compliance/liability). Rubber-stamping driven by time pressure, alert fatigue, information asymmetry, automation bias, workflow friction. 'Moral crumple zone' / accountability laundering: blame the human while they had no real power. Genuine oversight needs the human to have power AND a recorded, provable decision point — not a checkbox. Mitigations: rotate reviewers, train on AI failure modes, report errors back, track error types/rates over time.
